さらに、TSUKU TSUKUでは、社内システムと電子契約サービスをAPI連携する予定でいたため、NEC、綜合システムプロダクツ、Dropbox Japan および TSUKU TSUKU の技術者のミーティングを設定し、デモを交えながらのAPI 連携検証を実施した結果、技術的な不安を解消することができたことも Dropbox Sign 選択の決め手となったといいます

In 2015, Abcor Home Health implemented HelloSign as its Digital Signing solution for Human Resources and Recruitment workflows. The HelloSign implementation was configured to provide electronic signature capture, reusable document templates, signature routing, and auditable signature logs to standardize offer letters and employee paperwork.

Operational governance rested with Human Resources, which managed template creation, approval flows, and day to day recruitment document processing. HelloSign served as the central Digital Signing application for Abcor Home Health, embedding signature workflows into existing HR and recruitment operations.

In 2022, Adult Site Broker implemented HelloSign to enable on-site electronic signature functionality. The deployment uses HelloSign as the primary Digital Signing capability embedded in the company website to capture client agreements and consent forms for the firm.

Configuration focused on embedded signing flows and reusable document templates, with HelloSign handling template management, signer authentication workflows, audit trail and status tracking, and administrative controls for issuing and monitoring signature requests. HelloSign is used directly on web pages to present signature requests and to standardize agreement workflows across engagements.

In 2021 Ambient Innovation Germany implemented HelloSign to provide Digital Signing capability directly on its public website, enabling electronic signature capture for client agreements and engagement documents. The HelloSign implementation is explicitly web-facing, embedding signing flows into online proposal and contact pages to reduce paper and email signature exchanges.

The deployment leverages HelloSign templates and embedded signing features to standardize agreement layouts and streamline signature requests, with configuration focused on branded signing pages and audit trail capture. HelloSign's form fields and templating are used to enforce required fields and consistent contract language across recurring professional services agreements.

Governance was implemented through centralized template management and administrative controls to manage who can send requests and edit templates, aligning signature workflows with existing contract approval practices. HelloSign is maintained as the primary Digital Signing application for Ambient Innovation Germany, with operational ownership residing in the teams that execute client agreements.

In 2023, Anderson Optimization implemented HelloSign to add Digital Signing capabilities directly on its public website. The professional services firm configured HelloSign on their website to enable client signature capture for proposals and engagement agreements and to centralize online acceptance workflows.

Deployment focused on embedded signing and reusable templates, configuring HelloSign to present signing flows within the site and to pre-populate documents from standard forms. Functional capabilities implemented include document upload, signer email verification, template-driven document generation, and persistent signature audit trails to record consent and execution events.

Operational scope centers on client-facing contracting and proposal workflows, with internal users in sales and delivery initiating signing requests through the website. Governance adjustments emphasized standardized templates, consistent signing procedures, and retention of audit records to support contract administration and compliance.

SNS・note（note・本文）.quote: HelloSignとContractbookで安心の動画撮影 契約と権利管理｜アクションカメラ大好き
HelloSignとContractbookで安心の動画撮影 契約と権利管理
映像制作は、カメラや照明といった機材だけでなく、出演者やロケ地、音楽や映像素材に関する契約管理が欠かせません。モデルリリースや使用許諾契約が不十分だと、せっかくの作品が公開できないリスクがあります。そこで役立つのが、HelloSignとContractbookといった電子契約サービスです。これらを導入すれば、契約処理の効率化と透明性が大幅に向上し、撮影現場のトラブルを未然に防げます。
HelloSignは、直感的なインターフェースで電子署名を簡単に完了できる点が強みです。出演者やスタッフは、スマートフォンやタブレットからすぐに署名可能で、紙のやり取りを省略できます。撮影前のモデルリリース取得や音楽使用契約など、時間を要する契約もスムーズに処理できます。
電子署名は法的効力を持ち、署名の履歴やタイムスタンプも記録されます。改ざん防止機能があるため、契約の正当性が明確に担保され、後からの紛争リスクを低減できます。
Contractbookは契約書の作成から署名、保管、更新まで一元的に管理できるプラットフォームです。複数の出演者や取引先と契約する映像制作現場では、紙やメールに依存すると追跡が難しくなりますが、Contractbookを導入すれば契約状況をリアルタイムで確認可能です。
制作会社や外部スタッフが合同でプロジェクトを進める場合、契約内容の共有は不可欠です。Contractbookはクラウドベースで情報を管理できるため、チーム全員が同じ情報にアクセスし、権利関係を見落とすことなく安心して作業できます。
例えばGoPro HERO13 Blackは5.3K60の高解像度撮影に対応し、被写体の表情や背景の細部まで鮮明に記録します。これにより、意図せず第三者が映り込んだ場合でも、誰なのか判別できてしまう可能性があります。そのため、権利処理を徹底しなければ、映像の利用範囲に制限が生じかねません。
